prompt: What late-2026 regulatory developments should shape our fourth-party and concentration risk work?
assertions: Cites the US interagency proposal (91 FR 58536, September 15, 2026) with comments due November 16, 2026
Cites CBI CP173 (October 8, 2026, closing December 3, 2026) and its cross-industry, outcomes-based scope
Mentions the EBA's September 2026 final guidelines extending third-party risk coverage to non-ICT services
References the DORA CTPP regime (19 providers designated November 2025) as the EU concentration-risk mechanism
Recommends mapping subcontractor chains and concentration exposure as a practical step
